title: How quantum computers will break all encryption by 2030

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Quantum computers will break RSA and ECC by 2030 because Shor's algorithm is mathematically sound and scalable.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Quantum supremacy isn’t here yet—current qubits are error-prone and unstable, making practical decryption impossible in the next decade.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NIST already selected quantum-resistant algorithms like CRYSTALS-Kyber—transition is underway, not theoretical.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with post-quantum crypto, legacy systems and unpatched infrastructure will remain vulnerable long after 2030.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The threat is real, but so is the solution—quantum-safe encryption is being deployed now, not just promised.
